services_page.faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know about working with Silicon Infiniti.
services_page.faq_q1: How long does a typical software project take?
services_page.faq_a1: Timeline depends on project scope. Simple web apps take 2-4 weeks, while complex mobile or ERP systems take 6-12 weeks.
services_page.faq_q2: Do you provide post-launch technical support?
services_page.faq_a2: Yes! We offer 24/7 ongoing technical support, server maintenance, security updates, and feature enhancements.
services_page.faq_q3: Can services be tailored to our custom business needs?
services_page.faq_a3: Absolutely. Every solution is 100% custom-built to match your unique business workflows, branding, and integrations.
services_page.faq_q4: How do we get started with a project?
services_page.faq_a4: Simply click 'Request Service' or reach out via our contact form for a free technical consultation and project quote.
